172:         quantities: dict[uuid.UUID, int] = defaultdict(int)
173:         for item in body.items:
174:             quantities[item.product_id] += item.quantity
175:         product_ids = sorted(quantities, key=str)
176:         products = list(
177:             session.scalars(
178:                 select(Product)
179:                  .where(Product.id.in_(product_ids), Product.tenant_id == tenant)
180:                  .order_by(Product.id)
181:                  .with_for_update()
182:              )
183:          )
184:         if len(products) != len(product_ids):
185:             raise ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Product not found")
186:         for product in products:
187:             if product.stock < quantities[product.id]:
188:                 raise ApiError(409, "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "Insufficient stock")
189:         order = Order(tenant_id=tenant, status="PENDING", total_amount=0)
190:         session.add(order)
191:         session.flush()
192:         total = 0
193:         for product in products:
194:             quantity = quantities[product.id]
195:             product.stock -= quantity
196:             line_amount = product.unit_price * quantity
197:             total += line_amount
198:             session.add(
199:                 OrderItem(
200:                     order_id=order.id,
201:                     product_id=product.id,
202:                     sku=product.sku,
203:                     product_name=product.name,
204:                     unit_price=product.unit_price,
205:                     quantity=quantity,
206:                     line_amount=line_amount,
207:                  )
208:              )
209:         order.total_amount = total
210:         session.commit()
211:     except ApiError:
212:         session.rollback()
213:         raise
214: 
215:      # Store the successful idempotency result
216:     order = load_order(session, tenant, order.id)
217:     order_dict = {
218:          "id": str(order.id),
219:          "tenant_id": str(order.tenant_id),
220:          "status": order.status,
221:          "total_amount": order.total_amount,
222:          "created_at": order.created_at.isoformat(),
223:          "updated_at": order.updated_at.isoformat(),
224:          "items": [
225:              {
226:                  "id": str(item.id),
227:                  "order_id": str(item.order_id),
228:                  "product_id": str(item.product_id),
229:                  "sku": item.sku,
230:                  "product_name": item.product_name,
231:                  "unit_price": item.unit_price,
232:                  "quantity": item.quantity,
233:                  "line_amount": item.line_amount,
234:              }
235:             for item in order.items
236:          ],
237:      }
238:     response_body = json.dumps(order_dict)
239: 
240:      # Try to store the idempotency key
241:     idemp_key = IdempotencyKey(
242:         tenant_id=tenant,
243:         scope=scope,
244:         request_body=normalized_body,
245:         response_status=201,
246:         response_body=response_body,
247:      )
248:     session.add(idemp_key)
249:     try:
250:         session.commit()
251:     except IntegrityError:
252:          # Another concurrent request may have already stored this key
253:          # In this case, we need to return the existing order
254:         session.rollback()
255:         existing = session.scalar(
256:             select(IdempotencyKey)
257:              .where(
258:                 IdempotencyKey.tenant_id == tenant,
259:                 IdempotencyKey.scope == scope,
260:              )
261:              .with_for_update()
262:          )
263:         if existing is not None and existing.response_status == 201:
264:             stored_data = json.loads(existing.response_body)
265:             order_id = uuid.UUID(stored_data["id"])
266:             order = load_order(session, tenant, order_id)
267:             return order
268:          # If we get here, something unexpected happened
269:         raise
270: 
271:     session.expire_all()
272:     return order

275: @app.get("/orders/{order_id}", response_model=OrderOut)
276: def get_order(
277:     order_id: uuid.UUID,
278:     tenant: uuid.UUID = Depends(tenant_id),
279:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
280: ) -> Order:
281:     return load_order(session, tenant, order_id)

284: @app.post("/orders/{order_id}/cancel", response_model=OrderOut)
285: def cancel_order(
286:     order_id: uuid.UUID,
287:     tenant: uuid.UUID = Depends(tenant_id),
288:     session: Session = Depends(get_session),
289: ) -> Order:
290:     try:
291:         order = load_order(session, tenant, order_id, lock=True)
292:         if order.status != "PENDING":
293:             raise ApiError(409, "INVALID_ORDER_STATE", "Order cannot be canceled")
294:         product_ids = sorted((item.product_id for item in order.items), key=str)
295:         products = {
296:             product.id: product
297:             for product in session.scalars(
298:                 select(Product).where(Product.id.in_(product_ids)).order_by(Product.id).with_for_update()
299:              )
300:          }
301:         for item in order.items:
302:             products[item.product_id].stock += item.quantity
303:         order.status = "CANCELED"
304:         session.commit()
305:     except ApiError:
306:         session.rollback()
307:         raise
308:     session.expire_all()
309:     return load_order(session, tenant, order.id)
